title: A — Offset Register
prompt: Use case logo-brand. Design ONE premium minimalist logo concept board, landscape 1536x1024 composition. Solid opaque WHITE background everywhere except one clearly delimited black rectangular variant panel. No transparent background, gradients, glow, shadows, texture, photography, illustrations, decorative background, UI mockups, slogans or existing brand references. Original design from the supplied geometry; prioritize a distinctive reproducible silhouette. Very large hero symbol + lowercase wordmark on left upper half; standalone symbol on upper right. Lower third three neat isolated variants: pure BLACK ink on WHITE, pure WHITE on BLACK rectangle, and color app tile with WHITE symbol. All versions MUST use exactly same geometry. Only text is concept title and wordmark and small labels 'Primary', 'Monochrome', 'Reverse', 'App icon'. This is a preliminary original concept, not a cleared trademark. Invent a bespoke asymmetrical symbol from two solid interlocking but separated rectangular pieces. A tall left upright terminates in a rightward foot; an upper right compact rectangular piece has one deep horizontal white channel that stops before its right edge. The gap between the two pieces describes a single stepped off-center zigzag, evoking two time-ordered event records aligning. Strong silhouette, not generic letter L plus dot, not an E, not arrows, not ordinary bar chart. Forest green. Wordmark lowercase logly in carefully kerned contemporary grotesk. Concept title: A — Offset Register
